title: Suicide Bunny King's Crown Fight Your Fate Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crisp, clean, sweet and refreshing, King’s Crown’s Fight your Fate offers up a tangy lemonade laced with succulent strawberries. King's Crown is a gourmet E-Liquid line from vape legends Suicide Bunny that feature majestic combinations of sweet fruits, decadent desserts and refreshing beverages. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
